description: LH2Transfer models liquid-hydrogen transfer and boil-off between a feeding vessel and a receiving vessel. Its lumped mass and energy balances include vapour and liquid control volumes and cryogenic heat transfer. The provider is llnl (repository owner). Coverage: The model represents user-configured vessel and transfer conditions, commonly a trailer and stationary storage. No common geographic or observational coverage applies. Access: The public LLNL repository describes MATLAB scripts and inputs. The tested environment uses MATLAB R2013b and REFPROP 9.1 on Windows; none was installed. Licence and cost: The page does not establish a reuse licence or complete cost conditions. Provider confirmation is required before reuse. Limitations: The exact code licence was not established from the README excerpt. Proprietary dependencies and old tested versions limit immediate reproducibility. For simulation it supports hydrogen supply-chain loss and transfer-condition studies. Licence: NASA-1.3, read from the repository's licence file on 2026-09-27; obtaining it is free of charge. Related resources: No existing catalogue record explicitly identifies LH2Transfer.
